title: Pan-Seared Lamb Chops with Norwegian Inspiration
description: A simple and flavorful lamb dish with Norwegian twists, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This recipe combines the rich flavors of lamb with a hint of zesty freshness and a touch of winey depth.
instructions: 2. In a small bowl, whisk together lemon juice, red wine, and mustard to make the marinade
3. Place the lamb chops in a large ziplock bag and pour the marinade over them
4. Seal the bag and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight
5. Remove the lamb chops from the bag and season with salt and pepper
6. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
7. Add 2-3 lamb chops to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes per side
8. Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness
9. Remove the lamb chops from the skillet and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving
